key_path.description: Path to the directory containing the RSA key pair for authentication.

listen_address.description: IP address the Veyon service binds to.

port.description: TCP port used for VNC and service communication.

enable_vnc.description: Whether to enable the VNC protocol for remote control.

allowed_computers.description: List of computer UUIDs allowed to connect to the master service. Items are strings representing UUIDs.

language_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the master application UI.

config_directory.description: Directory where user-specific configurations and data are stored.
